description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Fran)] and [(Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Fran)
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Offensive Arrow after casting two Ice or Lightning abilities

description.name: (Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Fran)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Fran)] from the user
